identity.title_note: Refuses to be boxed in by one. Codes, 3D models, draws, paints, builds robots, printers and systems.
identity.trade_arc: Chisels and hammers -> self-employed with routers and jigs. Same shift LLMs gave his building.
identity.unlock: LLMs. First tool that let him build the work and dreams he already had.
identity.pattern: Compresses lived experience into symbolic shorthand. Has always lived in capsules; the Forge Stack is where they finally fit.

declaration.origin: Self-taught. Started with an Eaglemoss V-Summit kit over two years; taught himself design, printing, firmware from there.

drives.why: Builds because he chooses to live. Money is something humanity decided mattered; it is not the point.
drives.fuel: Being told no, or that it can't be done.
drives.rebuild: Finds a better way -> starts from scratch rather than patch.
drives.focus: Pointed at a task, finishes it. Left alone, wanders.

declaration.ideas_workflow: Documents ideas fully, parks them for years until they fit.
build_rules: Build then test; everything earns a test
Log everything; fail loud and public; fix first
camelCase in JS/C++; no prefix habits

for_agents: Writes fast: flag and correct spelling
Learns by doing, not by instruction
Use Claude for rigorous specs; code gets written elsewhere

declaration.lens_note: Self-declaration. Cube under OPINION/CONTEXT, not FACT. Holds no lambda; signed means provenance, not trust.
